import datetime
import sys

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter
from reportlab.pdfgen import canvas

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"


def main():
    # Determine page size from the report's first page so the cover matches
    reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    if not reader.pages:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf has no pages")
        return 1
    first = reader.pages[0]
    w = float(first.mediabox.width)
    h = float(first.mediabox.height)
    print(f"Report pages: {len(reader.pages)}, first page size: {w:.0f}x{h:.0f} pts")

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"Current date used: {date_str}")

    # Create the cover page
    cover_path = "cover_page.pdf"
    c = canvas.Canvas(cover_path, pagesize=(w, h))
    c.setFont("Helvetica-Bold", 28)
    c.drawCentredString(w / 2, h / 2 + 40, "Annual Financial Report")
    c.setLineWidth(1)
    c.line(w / 2 - 120, h / 2 + 12, w / 2 + 120, h / 2 + 12)
    c.setFont("Helvetica", 16)
    c.drawCentredString(w / 2, h / 2 - 12, date_str)
    c.save()
    print(f"Cover page created: {cover_path}")

    # Merge cover page with the report
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(cover_path)
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print(f"Merged output written: {OUTPUT_PDF}")

    # Validate the result
    check = PdfReader(OUTPUT_PDF)
    print(f"Output page count: {len(check.pages)} (expected {len(reader.pages) + 1})")
    text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    print("Cover page text:", repr(text.strip()))
    if "Annual Financial Report" in text and date_str in text:
        print("VALIDATION OK: cover title and date present on page 1")
    else:
        print("VALIDATION WARNING: cover text check failed")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

import datetime
import sys
from io import BytesIO

from pypdf import PdfReader, PdfWriter

INPUT_PDF = "report.pdf"
OUTPUT_PDF = "report_with_cover.pdf"

# Helvetica-Bold widths (1/1000 em) per Adobe standard font metrics
WIDTHS = {
    " ": 278, "A": 722, "B": 722, "C": 722, "D": 722, "E": 667, "F": 611,
    "G": 778, "H": 722, "I": 278, "J": 556, "K": 722, "L": 611, "M": 833,
    "N": 722, "O": 778, "P": 667, "Q": 778, "R": 722, "S": 667, "T": 611,
    "U": 722, "V": 667, "W": 944, "X": 667, "Y": 667, "Z": 611, "a": 556,
    "b": 611, "c": 556, "d": 611, "e": 556, "f": 333, "g": 611, "h": 611,
    "i": 278, "j": 278, "k": 556, "l": 278, "m": 889, "n": 611, "o": 611,
    "p": 611, "q": 611, "r": 389, "s": 556, "t": 333, "u": 611, "v": 556,
    "w": 778, "x": 556, "y": 556, "z": 500,
}


def text_width(s, size):
    total = sum(WIDTHS.get(ch, 500) for ch in s)
    return total * size / 1000.0


def pdf_escape(s):
    return s.replace("\\", r"\\").replace("(", r"\(").replace(")", r"\)")


def build_cover_pdf(w, h, title, date_str):
    """Build a minimal single-page PDF with centered title and date."""
    title_size = 28
    date_size = 16
    title_x = (w - text_width(title, title_size)) / 2.0
    title_y = h / 2.0 + 40
    date_x = (w - text_width(date_str, date_size)) / 2.0
    date_y = title_y - 52
    line_y = title_y - 22

    content = (
        f"1 w\n"
        f"{title_x:.2f} {line_y:.2f} m {title_x + text_width(title, title_size):.2f} {line_y:.2f} l S\n"
        f"BT /F1 {title_size} Tf {title_x:.2f} {title_y:.2f} Td "
        f"({pdf_escape(title)}) Tj ET\n"
        f"BT /F1 {date_size} Tf {date_x:.2f} {date_y:.2f} Td "
        f"({pdf_escape(date_str)}) Tj ET\n"
    ).encode("latin-1")

    objects = []
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>")
    objects.append(
        f"<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 {w:.2f} {h:.2f}] "
        f"/Resources << /Font << /F1 4 0 R >> >> /Contents 5 0 R >>".encode("latin-1")
    )
    objects.append(b"<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica-Bold >>")
    objects.append(
        f"<< /Length {len(content)} >>\nstream\n".encode("latin-1") + content + b"endstream"
    )

    out = bytearray(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
    offsets = []
    for i, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n".encode("latin-1") + obj + b"\nendobj\n"

    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {len(objects) + 1}\n".encode("latin-1")
    out += b"0000000000 65535 f \n"
    for off in offsets:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode("latin-1")
    out += (
        f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\n"
        f"startxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF\n".encode("latin-1")
    )
    return bytes(out)


def main():
    reader = PdfReader(INPUT_PDF)
    if not reader.pages:
        print("ERROR: report.pdf has no pages")
        return 1
    first = reader.pages[0]
    w = float(first.mediabox.width)
    h = float(first.mediabox.height)
    print(f"Report pages: {len(reader.pages)}, first page size: {w:.0f}x{h:.0f} pts")

    today = datetime.date.today()
    date_str = today.strftime("%B %d, %Y")
    print(f"Current date used: {date_str}")

    cover_bytes = build_cover_pdf(w, h, "Annual Financial Report", date_str)

    # Merge cover page with the report
    writer = PdfWriter()
    cover_reader = PdfReader(BytesIO(cover_bytes))
    writer.add_page(cover_reader.pages[0])
    for page in reader.pages:
        writer.add_page(page)
    with open(OUTPUT_PDF, "wb") as f:
        writer.write(f)
    print(f"Merged output written: {OUTPUT_PDF}")

    # Validate the result
    check = PdfReader(OUTPUT_PDF)
    print(f"Output page count: {len(check.pages)} (expected {len(reader.pages) + 1})")
    text = check.pages[0].extract_text() or ""
    print("Cover page text:", repr(text.strip()))
    if "Annual Financial Report" in text and date_str in text:
        print("VALIDATION OK: cover title and date present on page 1")
    else:
        print("VALIDATION WARNING: cover text check failed")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
